notes: Each pass is one rocprofv3 --pmc invocation (one full application run).
Pass sizing: <=8 SQ, <=4 TCC, <=4 TCP, <=2 GRBM counters per pass.
GRBM_GUI_ACTIVE is in every pass so each pass can be normalised by busy cycles on its own.
GRBM_GUI_ACTIVE / GRBM_COUNT are per XCC and rocprofv3 sums them over the 8 XCCs: divide by 8 to get GPU cycles (GUI_cycles). Verified: gives ~1815 MHz (job 433875).

Unit factors verified against job 433875: SQ_WAVE_CYCLES needs x4 (quad-cycles); SQ_BUSY_CU_CYCLES must NOT get x4; SQ_ACTIVE_INST_VALU is one quad-cycle per wave instruction; SQ_INST_CYCLES_SALU unverified (lower bound).
MI300X: 8 XCCs, CU_NUM=304, SIMD_NUM=1216, wave size 64, 512 VGPRs per SIMD lane (VGPR+AGPR unified), 64 KB LDS per CU, MFMA MOPS unit = 512 FLOPs, peak engine clock 2100 MHz.

MFMA: only FP64/FP32 MOPS are collected (all LAMMPS needs for FLOPs). SQ_VALU_MFMA_BUSY_CYCLES catches any other MFMA use: if it is > 0 while MOPS_F64 and MOPS_F32 are 0, low-precision MFMA ran and needs its own pass.
Memory is L2 -> memory traffic at the TCC_EA0 interface, before the 256 MB Infinity Cache: an upper bound on HBM traffic. Metrics are named mem_* rather than HBM_*.

Aggregation: sum counters and durations per kernel name within a pass; combine passes only through per-kernel rates (per ns) or per-launch averages. Launch IDs do not match across passes (QEq iteration counts vary ~0.5%).
duration_ns = End_Timestamp - Start_Timestamp per launch (counter CSV or kernel trace). GPU busy % of wall time comes from the power run's kernel trace, not from these passes.
Full explanation of every formula: post_processing_formulae.md.

passes.name: 01_fp64_flops
passes.label: FP64 FLOPs: vector (VALU) + matrix (MFMA) FP64 ops, MFMA busy

passes.name: 02_fp32_int_ops
passes.label: FP32 FLOPs (VALU + MFMA) and integer / conversion ops

passes.name: 03_fp16_instmix
passes.label: FP16 vector ops + instruction mix (scalar, memory, LDS)

passes.name: 04_cu_util
passes.label: CU utilization: GPU/CU/VALU busy, thread divergence, wave residency

passes.name: 05_hbm_read
passes.label: HBM reads: L2 -> memory read requests and bytes, incl. uncached

passes.name: 06_hbm_write
passes.label: HBM writes: L2 -> memory write requests and bytes, incl. uncached and atomics

derived.cycles: duration_ns * clock_MHz / 1000; clock_MHz = mean power-run gfx_clock_MHz over samples taken while a kernel ran (formulae.md 4.2)
derived.GUI_cycles: GRBM_GUI_ACTIVE / 8   [check only: includes per-launch profiler cycles]
derived.eff_clock_MHz: GUI_cycles / duration_ns * 1000   [check of the /8; not a frequency]
derived.GPU_busy_pct: 100 * union(kernel intervals) / (last end - first start)   [power-run kernel trace]
derived.max_waves_CU: min(4 * min(8, floor(512 / vgpr_alloc)), floor(65536 / LDS_Block_Size) * ceil(wg_threads / 64), 32); vgpr_alloc = ceil8(ceil4(VGPR)+AGPR) if AGPR>0 else ceil8(VGPR); wg_threads = X*Y*Z
derived.FP64_VALU_FLOP_useful: per kernel: FP64_VALU_FLOP * VALUUtilization_pct / 100   [pass 1 x pass 4]
derived.inst_share_pct: 100 * SQ_INSTS_X / (SQ_INSTS_VALU + SQ_INSTS_SALU + SQ_INSTS_VMEM_RD + SQ_INSTS_VMEM_WR + SQ_INSTS_LDS)   [pass 1 x pass 3, via rates]

peak_MI300X.notes: FP64 VALU = 304 CU x 128 FLOP/clk x 2.1 GHz. FP32 VALU 163.4 assumes packed FP32; unpacked FP32 is 81.7. MFMA FP64/FP32 = 304 x 256 FLOP/clk x 2.1 GHz. Scale by (measured clock / 2100) for clock-adjusted peaks.
peak_MI300X.PEAK_MEM_BW_note: HBM3 peak; the mem_* counters are measured before the Infinity Cache, so % of this peak is an upper bound on HBM use.
